items.text: has a desk plant named Kevin that everyone is worried about
arrives early for every exam and leaves the room first
pretends to read the reading list and only skims the summary
takes notes in five colours and never looks at them again
brings a pen to every meeting and never writes anything down
asks a question in the lecture that the slide already answers
stays late at the library and sleeps there
sends a reply-all just to say thanks
says let's circle back about absolutely everything
sends a print job with one page and walks over to the printer
saves ideas in a shared doc and forgets the password
has forty browser tabs open for one assignment
always offers to take notes and sends them three weeks later
joins the group project and posts only on the deadline
uses the word synergy in a conversation with their mum
has carried the same laptop charger in their bag for four years
hits snooze on the first lecture of the week, every week
makes a spreadsheet to decide which spreadsheet to make
books the meeting room and then works from home
says happy to help in a voice that clearly means no
logs their hours to the minute and forgets lunch
gives the coffee machine a name and regular feedback
asks for feedback on a draft and ignores every comment
sends a team lunch vote, then picks the café they wanted anyway
sits in the front row and still asks where the slides are
tags the whole team in a message from ten years ago
puts URGENT in every subject line
has an out-of-office that lasts longer than the holiday
creates a Trello board to track their Trello board
writes the essay in the most dramatic font the library allows
ends every meeting with let's touch base soon, then goes silent for a month
knows where the spare HDMI cable is and never admits it
takes three coffee breaks before ten in the morning
schedules a quick sync that lasts ninety minutes
keeps the conference lanyard on for a weekend brunch
